message: This ticket is not a specification for a change — it's an open-ended design discussion/RFC. The author is asking for input and opinions ("I need your input and possibly plan on the viability of this", "Thoughts?", "Should we update the agent part of the plan?") about pivoting HiveDispatch's architecture from a polling CLI dispatcher (see internal/dispatch, internal/schedule, cmd/hivedispatch/main.go) into an interactive multi-agent orchestration chat tool, plus replacing YAML config (internal/config, .hivedispatch.yaml) with in-app configuration. There is no concrete acceptance criteria, no specific file/function to change, and the questions posed (can polling run concurrently with per-device user prompting? should config move out of YAML?) are architectural decisions that need a human/product answer before any code can be written. This is exactly the kind of cross-cutting, undecided architectural proposal that shouldn't be auto-dispatched to a coding agent — it would have to invent the design itself.
